biotools.summary: StaphScope is an automated, locally-executable computational pipeline designed specifically for comprehensive Staphylococcus aureus genomic surveillance. It addresses the critical bottleneck in MRSA research by integrating seven essential genotyping methods into a single, cohesive workflow.
